# Imaging & pathology

Microscopy/WSI/DICOM, physiological imaging and rhythms, image data and neural recordings

## Selection examples

- **WSI tissue detection, tile extraction and basic preprocessing**: [`histolab`](histolab/SKILL.md); Read path: `skills/imaging-pathology/references/histolab/SKILL.md`. Use /opt/venv-histolab/bin/python for the installed histolab/openslide binding.
- **Multiplexed WSI analysis, tissue graphs or pathology ML**: [`pathml`](pathml/SKILL.md); Read path: `skills/imaging-pathology/references/pathml/SKILL.md`. Use bioimage-analysis for general microscopy segmentation/tracking.

## Methods

### bioimage-analysis

Method: [`bioimage-analysis`](bioimage-analysis/SKILL.md); Read path: `skills/imaging-pathology/references/bioimage-analysis/SKILL.md`.
Role: method. Source-declared name: `bioimage-analysis`.

Complete source description: Microscopy image analysis for cell biology. Cell segmentation (Cellpose, watershed), object tracking (trackpy), morphology quantification, colony counting, colocalization analysis, and cytoskeleton characterization. For pathology WSI use pathml; for flow cytometry use flow-cytometry-analysis.

### clinical-imaging

Method: [`clinical-imaging`](clinical-imaging/SKILL.md); Read path: `skills/imaging-pathology/references/clinical-imaging/SKILL.md`.
Role: method. Source-declared name: `clinical-imaging`.

Complete source description: Clinical and physiological imaging analysis. Diffusion MRI ADC maps, micro-CT bone morphometry, hemodynamic parameter analysis, circadian rhythm cosinor analysis, ciliary beat frequency (FFT), and tissue deformation optical flow. For DICOM file handling use pydicom; for biosignals use neurokit2.

### histolab

Method: [`histolab`](histolab/SKILL.md); Read path: `skills/imaging-pathology/references/histolab/SKILL.md`.
Role: toolkit. Source-declared name: `histolab`.

Complete source description: Lightweight WSI tile extraction and preprocessing. Use for basic slide processing tissue detection, tile extraction, stain normalization for H&E images. Best for simple pipelines, dataset preparation, quick tile-based analysis. For advanced spatial proteomics, multiplexed imaging, or deep learning pipelines use pathml.

Input/context examples (not prerequisites):
- H&E images

Source boundaries and alternatives:
- For advanced spatial proteomics, multiplexed imaging, or deep learning pipelines use pathml.

Search terms: WSI, H&E, tile extraction.

### neuropixels-analysis

Method: [`neuropixels-analysis`](neuropixels-analysis/SKILL.md); Read path: `skills/imaging-pathology/references/neuropixels-analysis/SKILL.md`.
Role: method. Source-declared name: `neuropixels-analysis`.

Complete source description: Neuropixels neural recording analysis. Load SpikeGLX/OpenEphys data, preprocess, motion correction, Kilosort4 spike sorting, quality metrics, Allen/IBL curation, AI-assisted visual analysis, for Neuropixels 1.0/2.0 extracellular electrophysiology. Use when working with neural recordings, spike sorting, extracellular electrophysiology, or when the user mentions Neuropixels, SpikeGLX, Open Ephys, Kilosort, quality metrics, or unit curation.

### pathml

Method: [`pathml`](pathml/SKILL.md); Read path: `skills/imaging-pathology/references/pathml/SKILL.md`.
Role: toolkit. Source-declared name: `pathml`.

Complete source description: Full-featured computational pathology toolkit. Use for advanced WSI analysis including multiplexed immunofluorescence (CODEX, Vectra), nucleus segmentation, tissue graph construction, and ML model training on pathology data. Supports 160+ slide formats. For simple tile extraction from H&E slides, histolab may be simpler.

Input/context examples (not prerequisites):
- pathology data

Source boundaries and alternatives:
- For simple tile extraction from H&E slides, histolab may be simpler.

Search terms: CODEX, Vectra, WSI.

Related methods:

### pydicom

Method: [`pydicom`](pydicom/SKILL.md); Read path: `skills/imaging-pathology/references/pydicom/SKILL.md`.
Role: toolkit. Source-declared name: `pydicom`.

Complete source description: Python library for working with DICOM (Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine) files. Use this skill when reading, writing, or modifying medical imaging data in DICOM format, extracting pixel data from medical images (CT, MRI, X-ray, ultrasound), anonymizing DICOM files, working with DICOM metadata and tags, converting DICOM images to other formats, handling compressed DICOM data, or processing medical imaging datasets. Applies to tasks involving medical image analysis, PACS systems, radiology workflows, and healthcare imaging applications.
